title: Forbidden configurations and definite fillings of lens spaces
summary: We study definite fillings of lens spaces. We classify the lens spaces $L(p,q)$ for which every smooth negative-definite filling $X$ satisfies \[ b_2(X)\ge b_2(X(p,q))-1, \] where $X(p,q)$ denotes the canonical negative-definite plumbing. The classification is given by 17 "forbidden configurations" that cannot appear as induced subgraphs of the canonical plumbing graph.
